# Diagnostic

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Structured, non-throwing report of a recoverable issue encountered while generating a PDF - most commonly a font that couldn't be loaded, an image that failed to decode, or a subset operation that fell back to embedding the full font. Callers retrieve the collected diagnostics from `Diagnostics` after Save / SaveAsync / GenerateBytes returns and decide how to surface them (log, display, ignore, throw).

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Diagnostic(DiagnosticSeverity severity, DiagnosticCategory category, string message, string source = null, Exception cause = null)
```

## Properties

- [`Category`](#category): The subsystem the issue came from.
- [`Cause`](#cause): The underlying exception, if any.
- [`Message`](#message): Human-readable description of the issue.
- [`Severity`](#severity): How serious the issue is.
- [`Source`](#source): Optional identifier of what the diagnostic is about (e.g. a font path).
